gizmo.title: Uqheliselo lwezibalo
gizmo.description: Uthotho olufutshane lweengxaki zezibalo ezenziweyo ezinengxelo kwangoko. Khetha imisebenzi noluhlu lwamanani; umjikelo ngamnye mtsha.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Igama lolu qheliselo, eliboniswa kwisihloko salo.

configure.title: Imisebenzi
configure.description: Ziziphi iintlobo zeengxaki ezibuzwayo. Abafundi bangacima nayiphi na kuzo ngaphambi kokuqala.

configure.title: Elona nani lincinci
configure.description: Elona nani lincinci elisetyenziswa kwingxaki. Amanani apheleleyo, 0 okanye ngaphezulu.

configure.title: Elona nani likhulu
configure.description: Elona nani likhulu elisetyenziswa kwingxaki. Iimpendulo zokwahlula nezahluli nazo zihlala kolu luhlu.

configure.title: Inani leengxaki
configure.description: Zingaphi iingxaki ezikumjikelo omnye (1 ukuya ku-100).

advanced.title: Umda wexesha
advanced.description: Imizuzwana evumelekileyo yomjikelo wonke. 0 kuthetha akukho sibali-xesha, nto leyo emiselweyo: uqheliselo olunexesha luyabahlula abafundi abafuna ixesha elingakumbi. Xa lisetiwe, abafundi basenokusicima isibali-xesha ngokwabo.

advanced.title: Umbala wogxininiso
advanced.description: Umbala wetshiphu yesihloko namaqhosha. Shiya kungenanto ukulandela umxholo.
